name: Can you convert an existing bathtub into a low threshold shower?

mainEntity.name: Can you convert an existing bathtub into a low threshold shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting a standard tub into a walk-in, low threshold shower is one of the most common accessibility updates for homeowners. The process involves removing the bathtub, reconfiguring the drain and water supply lines, and building moisture-resistant backing boards. Because standard tub drains are often 1.5 inches while shower drains require 2-inch piping to handle water runoff efficiently, licensed plumbing updates are typically required during the rough-in stage before custom tile work or prefabricated pans are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, standard bathtubs can be converted into low threshold showers by removing the tub, updating the drain to two inches, and installing custom tile or a walk-in pan.
